summary: FST Corp. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $10.4 million in ordinary shares via H.C. Wainwright as sales agent. The filing amends a prior inadvertent filing and is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or any other special event is involved. The ATM program allows periodic sales at market prices with a 3% commission to Wainwright. As a non-US filer, this maps to a US shelf takedown under an effective registration statement. No board recommendation, deal terms, or risk-arb angle applies, as this is purely a financing activity.
